title: Revisiting the Misspecified Cramér-Rao Bound
summary: Estimation under model misspecification arises in many signal processing problems, where the assumed observation model deviates from the true data-generating mechanism due to errors or simplifications. The misspecified Cramér-Rao bound (MCRB) is a widely recognized mean-squared-error (MSE) lower bound for this case, which has originally been used to describe the asymptotic behavior of the misspecified maximum likelihood (MML) estimator. Despite its widespread use, the MCRB lacks a rigorous characterization of the class of estimators for which it is valid. In this paper, we revisit the theory…
